import ast,pathlib,sys
external=set()
for p in pathlib.Path('scripts').rglob('*.py'):
 for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(p.read_bytes())):
  names=[a.name for a in n.names] if isinstance(n,ast.Import) else ([n.module] if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) and n.module and not n.level else [])
  external.update(name.split('.')[0] for name in names if name.split('.')[0] not in sys.stdlib_module_names)
assert not external, f'Undeclared external dependencies: {sorted(external)}'
print('Audit scripts use standard-library dependencies only')

import pathlib,zipfile,hashlib
files=['README.md','profile/README.md','products/README.md','SECURITY.md','LICENSE']
payload={name:pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() for name in files}
assert all(payload.values()), 'Empty public document'
output=pathlib.Path('/output/public-docs.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(output,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as z:
 for name in sorted(payload):
  info=zipfile.ZipInfo(name,date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0));info.external_attr=0o100644 << 16
  z.writestr(info,payload[name])
with zipfile.ZipFile(output) as z:
 assert sorted(z.namelist())==sorted(payload), 'Archive inventory mismatch'
 assert z.testzip() is None, 'Archive integrity failure'
 for name,content in payload.items(): assert z.read(name)==content, f'Archive/source mismatch: {name}'
print('Verified public documentation archive',hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
